name: memarium-plugin
description: Memarium Claude Code plugin: digest your AI coding sessions into chronicles + topics, recall past notes before new work. Standalone — works without the memarium npm CLI.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && esbuild src/plugin-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=bin/memarium-plugin.js --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && chmod +x bin/memarium-plugin.js
